summary: Comprehensive testing completed for DrepanHope Foundation donation website. All major features working correctly including bilingual support, donation flow, admin panel, and public pages.

integration_issues.issue: No visible success message shown after form submission (though API call succeeds)

passed_tests: Homepage loads with hero section, campaign cards, impact section
Language switcher toggles between EN and FR with localStorage persistence
Donate page shows campaign tabs and donation amount cards
Donation form submission saves to database and redirects to Thank You page
Campaign pages display details and donation CTA works
Transparency page shows reports and summary stats
Contact form accepts input and validates fields
Admin login works with provided credentials
Admin requires password change on first login (expected behavior)
All 13 backend API endpoints working correctly
Donation status can be updated via admin panel
Bilingual content displays correctly in both EN and FR

success_percentage.frontend: 95% (1 minor UI issue with contact form success message)

action_item_for_main_agent: Add success message display for contact form submission to improve user feedback
